mapper.select:
WITH months AS ( SELECT LEVEL AS month_no FROM dual CONNECT BY LEVEL <= 12 ),
ck_stats AS ( SELECT EXTRACT(MONTH FROM c.ck_date) AS month_no, COUNT(*) AS ck_count FROM ck c WHERE c.ck_date >= TO_DATE( #{year} || '-01-01', 'YYYY-MM-DD' ) AND c.ck_date < ADD_MONTHS( TO_DATE(#{year} || '-01-01', 'YYYY-MM-DD'), 12 ) GROUP BY EXTRACT(MONTH FROM c.ck_date) ),
participant_stats AS ( SELECT EXTRACT(MONTH FROM c.ck_date) AS month_no, COUNT(DISTINCT cp.ck_streamer) AS participant_count FROM ck c JOIN ck_participant cp ON cp.ck_id = c.ck_id WHERE c.ck_date >= TO_DATE( #{year} || '-01-01', 'YYYY-MM-DD' ) AND c.ck_date < ADD_MONTHS( TO_DATE(#{year} || '-01-01', 'YYYY-MM-DD'), 12 ) GROUP BY EXTRACT(MONTH FROM c.ck_date) ),
tournament_stats AS ( SELECT EXTRACT(MONTH FROM t.TOURNAMENT_START) AS month_no, COUNT(*) AS tournament_count FROM tournament t WHERE t.TOURNAMENT_START >= TO_DATE( #{year} || '-01-01', 'YYYY-MM-DD' ) AND t.TOURNAMENT_START < ADD_MONTHS( TO_DATE(#{year} || '-01-01', 'YYYY-MM-DD'), 12 ) GROUP BY EXTRACT(MONTH FROM t.TOURNAMENT_START) )
SELECT m.month_no AS MONTH_NO,
NVL(cs.ck_count, 0) AS CK_COUNT,
NVL(ps.participant_count, 0) AS PARTICIPANT_COUNT,
NVL(ts.tournament_count, 0) AS TOURNAMENT_COUNT,
t.id AS TOURNAMENT_ID,
t.TOURNAMENT_NAME AS TOURNAMENT_NAME
FROM months m
LEFT JOIN ck_stats cs ON cs.month_no = m.month_no
LEFT JOIN participant_stats ps ON ps.month_no = m.month_no
LEFT JOIN tournament_stats ts ON ts.month_no = m.month_no
LEFT JOIN tournament t ON EXTRACT(MONTH FROM t.TOURNAMENT_START) = m.month_no AND t.TOURNAMENT_START >= TO_DATE( #{year} || '-01-01', 'YYYY-MM-DD' ) AND t.TOURNAMENT_START < ADD_MONTHS( TO_DATE(#{year} || '-01-01', 'YYYY-MM-DD'), 12 )
ORDER BY m.month_no, t.TOURNAMENT_START, t.id
